name: Floating Contact Buttons by WebDeskArt
author: WebDeskArt

sections.description: Floating Contact Buttons is a lightweight plugin that displays sticky “Call Now” and “WhatsApp” buttons on your WordPress website. You can set your own phone number and WhatsApp message from the admin settings. The buttons are responsive and mobile-friendly, making it easier for users to contact you instantly.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/floating-contact-buttons-wda/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > Floating Contact Buttons to configure your phone number and WhatsApp message.
sections.faq:
Can I change the WhatsApp message?

Yes! You can customize it from the plugin settings page.

Will this work on mobile?

Absolutely. The plugin is fully responsive and optimized for mobile devices.
